params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, {{ci|Malzahar}} gains ''Void Shift'' until he takes non-{{tip|minion}} damage or negates a {{tip|crowd control}} effect, to which it then lingers for a brief time before expiring.
params.blurb2: ''Void Shift's'' {{sti|cooldown}} refreshes whenever '''Malzahar''' takes non-{{tip|minion}} damage or is affected by a {{tip|crowd control}} effect.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Void Shift:}} '''Malzahar''' gains {{tip|Cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} and massive damage reduction.
params.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Malzahar''' gains ''Void Shift'' until he takes non-{{tip|minion}} damage or negates a {{tip|crowd control}} effect, to which it then lingers for {{fd|0.25}} seconds before expiring.

{{sbc|Void Shift:}} '''Malzahar''' gains {{tip|Cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} and reduces incoming damage from non-minions by 90%.
params.description2: ''Void Shift's'' {{sti|cooldown}} refreshes whenever '''Malzahar''' takes non-{{tip|minion}} damage or is affected by a {{tip|crowd control}} effect, and resets upon [[death|respawning]].
params.notes:
* ''Void Shift'' will not resist allied {{tip|crowd control}} nor will it be deactivated by them.
* ''Void Shift'' will not mitigate {{tip|true damage}} but the buff will still be consumed.
** It does not deactivate against the {{tip|Nexus Obelisk}}.
* {{tip|Shield|Shields}} will take priority over ''Void Shift'', but the buff is always consumed, even if the shield fully mitigates the damage. {{bug}}
** However, if '''Malzahar''' has a {{tip|spell shield}} and is hit by an effect that isn't negated by the ''spell shield'', then if the {{tip|shield}} fully mitigates the damage, ''Void Shift'' will not be consumed.
* {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} take priority over ''Void Shift'' for abilities that contain a {{tip|crowd control}} effect.
* ''Void Shift'' will specifically not deactivate if '''Malzahar''' eats {{ui|Honeyfruit}} or is within a hostile {{ii|Frozen Heart}} passive [[aura]].
{{safesubst:unexpected|desc=
* ''Void Shift'' does not prevent {{cais|E|Zoe}} trap {{tip|drowsy}}. [https://www.reddit.com/r/zoemains/comments/1mfs9ib/did_you_know_malzahar_could_get_asleep_when/] {{bug|2}}|affectedEffects=Malzahar I; Zoe E|estimatedPatchOrigin=V9.6|<!--added automatically-->wikiUploadTimestamp=1776588526|<!--added automatically-->pagename=Template:Data Malzahar/Void Shift
}}
* ''Void Shift'' is special cased to prevent {{cai|Chum the Waters|Fizz}}, and {{cai|Death Sentence|Thresh}} from attaching to '''Malzahar'''.

blurb.plain: Innate: Periodically, Malzahar gains Void Shift until he takes non-minion damage or negates a crowd control effect, to which it then lingers for a brief time before expiring.

blurb2.plain: Void Shift's cooldown refreshes whenever Malzahar takes non-minion damage or is affected by a crowd control effect.

blurb4.plain: Void Shift: Malzahar gains crowd control immunity and massive damage reduction.

description.plain: Innate: Periodically, Malzahar gains Void Shift until he takes non-minion damage or negates a crowd control effect, to which it then lingers for 0.25 seconds before expiring. Void Shift: Malzahar gains crowd control immunity and reduces incoming damage from non-minions by 90%.

description2.plain: Void Shift's cooldown refreshes whenever Malzahar takes non-minion damage or is affected by a crowd control effect, and resets upon respawning.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Malzahar}} opens two portals to the void at the target location that last a brief time, which then deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies between and briefly {{tip|silence}} them.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malzahar''' opens two portals to the void centered at the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area in between. After {{fd|0.4}} seconds, enemies between the portals are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|silence|silenced}} for a duration.
params.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}}}
{{st|Silence Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}
params.notes:
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will prevent ''Call of the Void's'' refresh on {{ai|Malefic Visions|Malzahar}}.
** {{ais|Malefic Visions|Malzahar}} debuff will also be removed.{{bug|2}}

blurb.plain: Active: Malzahar opens two portals to the void at the target location that last a brief time, which then deal magic damage to enemies between and briefly silence them.

description.plain: Active: Malzahar opens two portals to the void centered at the target location, granting sight of the area in between. After 0.4 seconds, enemies between the portals are dealt magic damage and silenced for a duration.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Malzahar}} generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' when he casts another {{tip|ability}}, up to a maximum.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malzahar''' consumes all ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stacks to summon a {{ui|Voidling}} at the target location. Additional ''Voidlings'' are then summoned for each ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stack consumed.
params.blurb3: ''Voidlings'' target nearby enemies and deal {{as|magic damage}} with their attacks, prioritizing those targeted by ''{{ai|Malefic Visions|Malzahar}}'' and ''{{ai|Nether Grasp|Malzahar}}''.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Malzahar''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' when he casts another {{tip|ability}}, up to a maximum of 2.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malzahar''' consumes all ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stacks and, after a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay, summons a {{ui|Voidling}} at the target location. Additional ''Voidlings'' are then summoned for each ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stack consumed, with each ''Voidling'' being summoned {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the previous one.
params.description3: ''Voidlings'' deal {{as|magic damage}} with their attacks, reduced by 50% against epic {{tip|monsters}} and increased by 200% to enemy {{tip|minions}} infected by ''{{ai|Malefic Visions|Malzahar}}''.
params.notes:
* '''Malzahar''' loses all {{tip|stacks}} upon {{tip|death}}.
* ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stacks are gained per cast and not per ability activation. For example, if {{ai|Malefic Visions|Malzahar}} is cast and the ability cancels under certain circumstances, a ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stack will still be granted despite the ability's failure to complete.

blurb.plain: Passive: Malzahar generates a stack of Zz'Rot Swarm when he casts another ability, up to a maximum.

blurb2.plain: Active: Malzahar consumes all Zz'Rot Swarm stacks to summon a Voidling at the target location. Additional Voidlings are then summoned for each Zz'Rot Swarm stack consumed.

blurb3.plain: Voidlings target nearby enemies and deal magic damage with their attacks, prioritizing those targeted by Malefic Visions and Nether Grasp.

description.plain: Passive: Malzahar generates a stack of Zz'Rot Swarm when he casts another ability, up to a maximum of 2.

description2.plain: Active: Malzahar consumes all Zz'Rot Swarm stacks and, after a 0.5-second delay, summons a Voidling at the target location. Additional Voidlings are then summoned for each Zz'Rot Swarm stack consumed, with each Voidling being summoned 0.5 seconds after the previous one.

description3.plain: Voidlings deal magic damage with their attacks, reduced by 50% against epic monsters and increased by 200% to enemy minions infected by Malefic Visions.

description4.plain: See Pets for more details about Voidlings.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Malzahar}} infects the target enemy's mind, continually dealing {{as|magic damage}} over a few seconds, which refreshes upon damaging them with ''{{ai|Call of the Void|Malzahar}}'' or ''{{ai|Nether Grasp|Malzahar}}''.
params.blurb2: If the target dies while infected, they spread ''Malefic Visions'' onto the closest nearby enemy and '''Malzahar''' restores a portion of {{sti|mana|{{as|his '''maximum''' mana}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malzahar''' infects the target enemy's mind, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over 4 seconds, which refreshes upon damaging them with ''{{ai|Call of the Void|Malzahar}}'' or ''{{ai|Nether Grasp|Malzahar}}''. ''Malefic Visions'' executes {{tip|minions}} if they would be damaged below {{sti|health|{{as|{{pp|10 to 30 for 11}} health}}}}.
params.leveling: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 220}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|80/16 to 220/16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80/16}}% AP)}}}}
params.description2: If the target dies while infected, they spread ''Malefic Visions'' onto the closest nearby enemy and '''Malzahar''' restores {{sti|mana|{{as|2% of his '''maximum''' mana}}}}.
params.notes:
* ''Malefic Visions'' deals {{tip|persistent damage}}, additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}}, and applies {{tip|spell effects}}.
* ''Malefic Vision's'' cast is special cased to not be cancelled if the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or is too far away or no longer in {{tip|sight}} during the cast time.
** The debuff is not applied if the target is untargetable by the time the cast completes.

blurb.plain: Active: Malzahar infects the target enemy's mind, continually dealing magic damage over a few seconds, which refreshes upon damaging them with Call of the Void or Nether Grasp.

blurb2.plain: If the target dies while infected, they spread Malefic Visions onto the closest nearby enemy and Malzahar restores a portion of his maximum mana.

description.plain: Active: Malzahar infects the target enemy's mind, dealing magic damage every 0.25 seconds over 4 seconds, which refreshes upon damaging them with Call of the Void or Nether Grasp. Malefic Visions executes minions if they would be damaged below 10 – 30 (based on level) health.

description2.plain: If the target dies while infected, they spread Malefic Visions onto the closest nearby enemy and Malzahar restores 2% of his maximum mana.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Malzahar}} {{tip|tether|tethers}} to the target enemy champion, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}}. The tether lasts a short time, during which he {{tip|channel|channels}} to {{tip|suppression|suppress}} and {{tip|true sight|reveal}} the target, continually dealing them {{as|magic damage}}.
params.blurb2: Additionally, a ''Null Zone'' is opened beneath the target's location for a few seconds, which continually deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malzahar''' {{tip|tether|tethers}} to the target enemy champion, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}}. He then {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds, {{tip|suppression|suppressing}} and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} the target and dealing them {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, {{tip|sight|revealing}} himself in the process.
params.leveling: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|125 to 275}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|125/10 to 275/10}} {{as|(+ 8% AP)}}}}
params.description2: '''''Malzahar''' will continue to channel as long as the tether is not broken, even if the suppression is removed.''
params.description3: Additionally, a ''Null Zone'' is opened beneath the target's location at the time of cast that lasts 5 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to enemies within, capped at 120 per tick against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
params.leveling3: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|10 to 20}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{as|{{ap|10/10 to 20/10}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.25}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
params.description4: ''Null Zone will persist even if the channel is interrupted.
params.notes:
* Applies {{tip|persistent damage}} for the {{tip|tether}}, and {{tip|persistent area damage}} additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage|indirect}} to enemies within the ''Null Zone''.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} prevents both the tether and the ''Null Zone'' from appearing, however '''Malzahar''' will continue to ''channel''. [https://www.reddit.com/r/Sivir/comments/g7yt38/if_you_shield_malzahar_ult_he_ironically_gets_ccd/]
* The tether will not break if the target enters a {{tip|zombie state}} or enters {{tip|resurrection}}.
* As long as the target is within the tether radius, they will take the full tether damage over {{fd|2.5}} seconds even if they are not tethered due to the tether being broken early into the channel.{{bug}}
** This occurs regardless of how the tether was broken.
** If the target exits tether range they will stop taking damage, but can be damaged again by the remaining ticks if they re-enter the tether range within the duration.
* Removing the {{tip|suppression}} will also remove the {{tip|true sight|reveal}}.
* '''Malzahar''' places himself onto the ground and interrupts {{tip|airborne|displacements}} affecting him upon starting the ''channel''.
* If a target is currently being affected by ''{{ai|Malefic Visions|Malzahar}}'', casting ''Nether Grasp'' on them will grant 2 stacks toward effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}}.{{bug}}
** This is, correctly, not the case if ''Nether Grasp'' is cast before ''Malefic Visions''.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Malzahar''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
** The channel will be interrupted if the tether is broken.

blurb.plain: Active: Malzahar tethers to the target enemy champion, knocking them down. The tether lasts a short time, during which he channels to suppress and reveal the target, continually dealing them magic damage.

blurb2.plain: Additionally, a Null Zone is opened beneath the target's location for a few seconds, which continually deals magic damage to enemies within.

description.plain: Active: Malzahar tethers to the target enemy champion, knocking them down. He then channels for up to 2.5 seconds, suppressing and revealing the target and dealing them magic damage every 0.25 seconds, revealing himself in the process.

description2.plain: Malzahar will continue to channel as long as the tether is not broken, even if the suppression is removed.

description3.plain: Additionally, a Null Zone is opened beneath the target's location at the time of cast that lasts 5 seconds, dealing magic damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies within, capped at 120 per tick against minions and monsters.

description4.plain: Null Zone will persist even if the channel is interrupted.
